keyEvents.text: Goal! Levante 0, Atletico Madrid 1. Alejandro Grimaldo (Atletico Madrid) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner.
First Half ends, Levante 0, Atletico Madrid 1.
Goal! Levante 0, Atletico Madrid 2. Giuliano Simeone (Atletico Madrid) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Álex Baena with a through ball.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Jonathan David replaces Lee Kang-In.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Alexander Sørloth replaces Julián Alvarez.
Substitution, Levante. Adrián de la Fuente replaces Jeremy Toljan.
Substitution, Levante. Petar Ratkov replaces Dani Requena.
Substitution, Levante. Víctor García replaces Karl Etta Eyong.
Substitution, Levante. Oriol Rey replaces Thiago Fernández.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Robin Le Normand replaces Pablo Barrios.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Ademola Lookman replaces Álex Baena.
Substitution, Levante. Marc Santos replaces Nacho Pérez.
